title: Can playing video games help you get a better job? ｜ 打电子游戏能帮你找到更好的工作吗？

sents.en: The gaming industry is larger than films and music combined, yet few of us are likely to list our achievements in playing computer games as work experience in our resume.
sents.cn: 游戏产业的规模比电影和音乐加起来还大，但我们当中很少有人会把自己的电脑游戏成就列为简历上的工作经验。

sents.en: But why not?
sents.cn: 但为什么不呢？

sents.en: Businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring to the workplace.
sents.cn: 企业正逐渐意识到玩家能为职场带来的技能。

sents.en: One start-up is convinced that the skills learned by playing games · hard-won through years of training and battle · can be applied to real-life work situations.
sents.cn: 一家初创公司坚信，通过多年训练和实战辛苦练就的游戏技能，可以应用到真实的工作情境中。

sents.en: And Game Academy reckons its belief is backed up by hard data.
sents.cn: GameAcademy认为，它的这一信念有硬数据支撑。

sents.en: Do you enjoy unusual puzzle games like Portal, or tower defence games like Defense Grid?
sents.cn: 你喜欢《Portal》这类不寻常的解谜游戏，还是《DefenseGrid》这类塔防游戏？

sents.en: The team has found that IT workers play those more than average.
sents.cn: 该团队发现，IT工作者玩这些游戏的频率高于平均水平。

sents.en: But if you prefer Civilization, Total War, or X-Com, where strategy and resource management are key, then you might have more in common with managers.
sents.cn: 但如果你偏爱《Civilization》《TotalWar》或《X-Com》这类以策略和资源管理为核心的游戏，那么你可能与管理者有更多共同点。

sents.en: Game Academy's idea is simple: analyse gamers' habits from their online gaming profile, and offer courses in valuable skills that reflect their aptitudes · skills they can practise and refine in-game.
sents.cn: GameAcademy的思路很简单：从玩家的在线游戏档案中分析其习惯，并提供能反映其天资的实用技能课程——这些技能他们可以在游戏内练习并精进。

sents.en: And there is already a growing acceptance that gaming skills are transferable.
sents.cn: 而且，游戏技能具有可迁移性，正获得越来越多的认可

sents.en: Even the military is hiring gamers.
sents.cn: 甚至连军方也在招募玩家。

sents.en: ·The ability to absorb information, react swiftly and coordinate actions whilst remaining calm under pressure are often attributes of people that are good at gaming,· according to a Royal Air Force spokesperson.
sents.cn: 据英国皇家空军一位发言人说："吸收信息、迅速反应、在压力下保持冷静地协调行动的能力，往往是擅长游戏之人的特质。

sents.en: Those skills are part of what the Royal Air Force is looking for ·in a variety of roles·.
sents.cn: "这些技能正是皇家空军在"各类岗位"上所看重的。

sents.en: · Skills acquired through gaming can be very relevant to certain areas.·
sents.cn: "通过游戏获得的技能可能与某些领域高度相关。"

sents.en: ·There are plenty of soft skills that gamers can utilise in a professional setting, such as teamwork, problem solving and strategic planning,· says Ryan Gardner, a regional director with Hays recruitment.
sents.cn: "玩家能在职业环境中运用大量软技能，比如团队合作、解决问题和战略规划，"Hays招聘公司的区域总监瑞恩∙加德纳（RyanGardner）说。

sents.en: But does that really mean your top 100 ranking in Overwatch should go down in your resume?
sents.cn: 但这真的意味着你在《守望先锋》中的前100名排名该写进简历吗？

sents.en: ·It's about how you either make it relevant to the job you are applying for, or how it makes you more interesting as a potential employee,· Mr. Gardner says.
sents.cn: "关键在于你如何让它与你应聘的工作产生关联，或者它如何让你作为潜在雇员更具吸引力，"加德纳先生说。

sents.en: Two years ago, a Glasgow University study made headlines for suggesting gaming could make students more successful.
sents.cn: 两年前，格拉斯哥大学的一项研究因提出"游戏能让学生更成功"而登上头条。

sents.en: But ·the research hasn't really changed minds, at least not yet,· says one of the authors of the study, Dr. Matthew Barr.
sents.cn: 但该研究作者之一马修∙巴尔（MatthewBarr）博士说："这项研究并没有真正改变人们的看法，至少目前还没有。

sents.en: He's now writing a book on the topic.
sents.cn: "他目前正在就此话题写一本书。

sents.en: ·For now, I think the negative reputation around games means that telling someone you're a determined gamer is more likely to harm your chances of getting a job.
sents.cn: "眼下，我认为游戏周围的负面名声意味着，告诉别人你是个坚定的游戏玩家，更可能损害你找到工作的机会。

sents.en: But if someone can explain how they've led a team in an online game, for example, they may be able to persuade an employer that this is useful,· says Dr Barr.
sents.cn: 但如果有人能解释自己如何在网游中带领过团队，例如，他们或许能说服雇主这很有用，"巴尔博士说。

sents.en: Playing games casually is unlikely to help your career prospects.
sents.cn: 漫不经心地玩游戏不大可能助长你的职业前景。

sents.en: But part of Game Academy's suggestion is to transform casual gamers into ·conscious· ones, applying critical thinking to developing their skills.
sents.cn: 但GameAcademy的建议之一是，把休闲玩家转变为"有意识"的玩家，用批判性思维来发展自己的技能。

sents.en: ·We see gameplay as a resource of talent, · says co-founder David Barrie.
sents.cn: "我们把游戏玩法视为一种人才资源，"联合创始人戴维∙巴里（DavidBarrie）说。

sents.en: ·Why can't we put in our resume our gaming victories and achievements?· he asks.
sents.cn: "我们为什么不能把游戏中的胜利和成就写进简历？"他问道。

sents.en: ·If they say they want leadership · why can't I point to my years of leading World of Warcraft raids?·
sents.cn: "如果他们说想要领导力——我为什么不能指着我多年带领《魔兽世界》团本的经验？"

sents.en: There are already plenty of gamers out there who know that their hobby has made them who they are.
sents.cn: 已经有许多玩家深知，是自己的爱好塑造了今天的自己。

sents.en: Earlier this year, Matthew Ricci told gaming site Kotaku: ·If you're playing EVE Online you basically already have an MBA.· Often made fun of in gaming circles as a “spreadsheet simulator (电子表格模拟器)”, the economy of the fictional EVE universe is driven by real market principles.
sents.cn: 今年早些时候，马修∙里奇（MatthewRicci）对游戏网站Kotaku说："如果你在玩《星战前夜》（EVEOnline），你基本上就已经有了MBA。

sents.en: If you want to build a new spaceship, the raw material has to be mined by another player.
sents.cn: "在游戏圈里常被调侃为"电子表格模拟器"的EVE虚构宇宙，其经济由真实的市场原则驱动。

sents.en: Manufacturing costs come into effect, and commodities fluctuate in price based on demand and the distance to haul the commodity.
sents.cn: 如果你想造一艘新飞船，原材料必须由另一名玩家开采。制造成本会发挥作用，而商品价格会根据需求和运输距离而波动。

sents.en: Mr. Ricci, who had always dreamed of being the boss of his own company, ran an in-game corporation comprising hundreds of players.
sents.cn: 里奇先生一直梦想成为自己公司的老板，他运营过一个由数百名玩家组成的游戏内公司。

sents.en: Eventually, he realised he could transfer his skills to real-life business · instead of doing it for free.
sents.cn: 最终，他意识到自己可以把技能迁移到现实生意中——而不再是免费做这件事。

sents.en: He restructured Zentech, once a taxation vehicle for his father's business, and it is now in its fourth year helping international brands enter the Canadian market.
sents.cn: 他重组了Zentech（这家公司原本是他父亲生意的税务工具），如今它已进入第四年，帮助国际品牌进入加拿大市场。

sents.en: EVE teaches skills like creativity, leadership, organisation, and conflict resolution, he maintains.
sents.cn: 他坚持认为，EVE传授了创造力、领导力、组织能力和冲突解决等技能。

sents.en: He credits his success to his family, his strong desire to run his own business · and ·a damn good company in Iceland that made a damn good game·.
sents.cn: 他把成功归功于家人、自己经营公司的强烈愿望，以及"冰岛一家非常出色的公司，做出了非常出色的游戏"。

sents.en: Digital entrepreneur and business consultant Mia Bennett says: ·In more traditional settings, gaming is still imagined to be the pursuit of teenage boys · a waste of time.
sents.cn: 数字企业家兼商业顾问米娅∙贝内特（MiaBennett）说："在更传统的环境里，游戏仍被视为青少年男孩的消遣——一种时间浪费。

sents.en: · But there are some links to skills like ·decision-making, the ability to anticipate and future planning,· she says.
sents.cn: "但她指出，游戏与"决策能力、预见未来的能力以及长远规划"等技能存在某些联系。

sents.en: ·It also helps with meta-skills · learning how to learn, experimentation, and creative thinking.·
sents.cn: "它也有助于元技能——学会如何学习、尝试实验以及创造性思考。"

sents.en: Twelve years into his career, Mark Long, a radiotherapy physicist with the NHS in Surrey, doesn't get as much gaming time as he used to.
sents.cn: 在萨里郡国民保健署（NHS）担任放疗物理学家的马克∙朗（MarkLong），入行十二年，已不像过去那样有那么多游戏时间了。

sents.en: ·I would love to say that my gaming skills allow me to destroy cancer using linear accelerators like photon (光子) blasters, but that's not quite the reality.· Instead, he credits old-school games like Palace of Magic with exposing him to computers.
sents.cn: "我很想说，我的游戏技能让我能像用光子炮那样用直线加速器消灭癌症，但现实并非如此。"相反，他把《魔法宫殿》这类老派游戏归功于让自己接触了计算机。

sents.en: Every new gaming upgrade improved his knowledge of how they worked.
sents.cn: 每一次游戏升级都增进了他对计算机运作方式的了解。

sents.en: Gaming also encouraged a competitive spirit · and that, he believes, translates.
sents.cn: 游戏还培养了他的竞争精神——而他认为，这种精神可以迁移。

sents.en: ·When creating treatment plans, the aim is to optimise the radiation dose to the tumour and restrict it as much as possible to healthy surrounding tissues and organs,· he says.
sents.cn: "在制定治疗方案时，目标是优化对肿瘤的辐射剂量，并尽可能把它限制在健康的周围组织和器官上，"他说。

sents.en: It's about ·repeating the process, but each time doing something slightly different to improve the result·.
sents.cn: 这关乎"重复这一过程，但每次都做一点不同的事以改进结果"。

sents.en: Not unlike achieving a high score or a perfect run.
sents.cn: 这与取得高分或完美通关并无二致。

sents.en: ·Most videogames are essentially puzzles to solve,· he says.
sents.cn: "大多数电子游戏本质上都是待解的谜题，"他说。

sents.en: ·And problem-solving is a big part of my job.·
sents.cn: "而解决问题正是我工作的很大一部分。"

sents.en: Over at Game Academy, Mr. Barrie is aware they still have a mountain to climb.
sents.cn: 在GameAcademy，巴里先生明白他们仍有高山要攀。

sents.en: ·The employer community will need the science,· he says, but confesses he only became a true believer when he started asking players about their biggest in-game achievements.
sents.cn: "雇主群体需要科学依据，"他说，但他承认，只有当他开始询问玩家最大的游戏内成就时，才真正信服。

sents.en: ·The scale and scope of their answers were amazing,· he says.
sents.cn: "他们回答的规模和范围令人惊叹，"他说。

sents.en: ·But ask them the same about their work, and they don't know.· ·The engagement and powerful skills that people get playing a game · why can't work be like that?· he asks.
sents.cn: "但问他们同样关于工作的问题，他们却答不上来。""人们玩游戏时所获得的投入感和强大技能——为什么工作不能像那样？"他问道。
